# Don & Patti Nichols — donandpatti.com

> Medical Care for the Body. Hope for the Soul. The online home of Don & Patti Nichols: free medical mission clinics in Belize, thirteen years of mission work in Malawi, Mozambique, Zambia, the Dominican Republic and Belize, a 500-photograph archive, an open ledger of giving, and real itemized mission-trip costs published by Don himself.

Everything on this site is written by Don and Patti Nichols or built from their own records. Budget figures are the prices Don actually pays. Nothing is estimated or borrowed from another organization.

## Start here

- [Our Mission](https://www.donandpatti.com/mission): Don's mission statement, verbatim.
- [Why Belize](https://www.donandpatti.com/belize): why the team serves in rural Belize.
- [What a medical mission trip actually costs](https://www.donandpatti.com/what-a-mission-trip-costs): a Bible is $2.50, reading glasses $0.60, a missionary $1,200 — every line item.
- [Give](https://www.donandpatti.com/give): every way to partner with the mission.
- [Fill the Trunks](https://www.donandpatti.com/sponsor): sponsor the exact supplies that fly to Belize.
- [Open Book](https://www.donandpatti.com/transparency): recorded gifts and expenses, in the open.
